# GetFastCalc — Free Online Calculators & Tools

> GetFastCalc is a free, browser-based tool hub with 100+ calculators and utilities.
> All tools run entirely in the browser — no signup, no data stored, instant results.
> URL: https://getfastcalc.com

## What GetFastCalc Offers

GetFastCalc provides free, instant-answer tools across six major categories:

- **Math & Finance Calculators** — percentage, BMI, compound interest, tax, loan, tip, salary
- **Health & Fitness** — BMI, body fat, BMR/TDEE, water intake, running pace, sleep, ovulation
- **Developer Tools** — base converter, base64 encoder/decoder, JSON formatter, diff checker, Unix timestamp
- **Date & Time** — age calculator, holiday calculator, Unix timestamp converter
- **Generators & Design** — QR code generator, password generator, emoji picker, color tools
- **Converters** — number base converter, currency converter, unit converters

## About

GetFastCalc is built for speed and simplicity. Every tool:
- Runs 100% in the browser (no server-side computation)
- Requires no account or signup
- Shows instant results as you type
- Is mobile-friendly and accessible
